shorts.title: GTA 6: 3 Police Mistakes Keeping You Wanted
shorts.description:
In GTA 6, red stars don't mean you're clear (cops can spot your face, clothes and car), switch your getaway car once it's spotted, and don't go back to the scene.
Which one got you? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Are You Using Focus?
shorts.description:
Click both sticks in GTA 6 (L3 + R3 or LS + RS) to use Focus. It highlights weak spots, engines, tires, cops and valuables. Watch the purple eye meter.
Did you know about Focus? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: Don't Start Tourist Trap Yet
shorts.description:
Tourist Trap is GTA 6's Chapter 1 point of no return: no free roam until Chapter 2, and Jason's house is gone for good. Make a manual save in a separate slot first.
Did you start it already? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: How to Unlock Bank Vault Jobs in GTA 6
shorts.description:
Finish VCIA Takedown and look for Wait at the Cafe. Taking every marked bill from the first vault is worth about $80,000 in-game.
#gta6 #gtavi #shorts
